players.name: Enzo De Pina Duarte Dos Santos

events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Sabah 0, Borussia Dortmund 1. Serhou Guirassy (Borussia Dortmund) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Ramy Bensebaini (Borussia Dortmund).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Steve Solvet (Sabah) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Sabah 1, Borussia Dortmund 1. Aden McCarthy (Sabah) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Tymoteusz Puchacz with a cross following a set piece situation.
First Half ends, Sabah 1, Borussia Dortmund 1.
Ivan Lepinjica (Sabah) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Sabah 1, Borussia Dortmund 2. Serhou Guirassy (Borussia Dortmund) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Joey Veerman with a cross.
Aden McCarthy (Sabah) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sabah. Aleksey Isayev replaces Du Queiroz.
Substitution, Sabah. Orphé Mbina replaces Kaheem Parris.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Marcel Sabitzer replaces Carney Chukwuemeka.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Jobe Bellingham replaces Felix Nmecha.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Joane Gadou replaces Ramy Bensebaini.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Maximilian Beier replaces Daniel Svensson.
Substitution, Sabah. Abdulla Xaybulayev replaces Umarali Rakhmonaliev.
